subject: Aligning on 30-min product tour + tech attendee list
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Kapoor <maya.kapoor@talentgrid.io>, TalentGrid CTO <cto@talentgrid.io>
Cc: procurement@talentgrid.io
Date: 2026-12-05T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Aligning on next steps + 30-min product tour

Hi Maya / Team,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciated the clear breakdown of TalentGrid's inference bottlenecks (cost-per-token and inconsistent tail latency during peak batch scoring). Quick recap:

- Primary goal: reliable 99th-percentile latency for real-time recommendations (sub-200ms target)
- Secondary: reduce per-token cost for nightly bulk scoring jobs
- Security considerations: data residency for EU customers and SOC2 evidence for procurement

Next step: we'd like to schedule a 30-minute product tour where Monica (solutions engineering) can walk through the runtime, routing/fallback behavior, and a short Q&A on quantization profiles. Can you confirm which of these windows works for your team next week (PT times):

Option A — Tue 12/08, 9:00–9:30 AM PT
Option B — Wed 12/09, 1:30–2:00 PM PT
Option C — Thu 12/10, 11:00–11:30 AM PT

Please also confirm which stakeholders will attend (CTO? Head of Infra? Security/Procurement?). I’ll include Monica on the invite and attach a short discovery notes PDF and our initial security checklist for procurement to review.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/sean-30m (if you prefer to pick directly)

Thanks — looking forward to aligning calendars.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0191

Attachments: DiscoveryNotes-TalentGrid.pdf; talentgrid-security-q1.xlsx

From: Maya Kapoor <maya.kapoor@talentgrid.io>

Subject: Re: Aligning on next steps + 30-min product tour

Hi Sean — thanks for the clear recap. All three windows look doable for us, but the most convenient is Option B (Wed 12/09 1:30 PM PT).

Attendees: Myself (Head of Product), Vivek Rao (CTO), Priya Suresh (Head of Infra). Procurement will join asynchronously; they asked for the security checklist you attached and will follow up with a few questions.

I’ve tentatively blocked the slot on our side — please send a calendar invite to confirm.

Cheers,
Maya
